user.title: Home Maintenance Manager
user.description: Name your property and individually select maintenance tasks to track.

init.title: Home Maintenance Manager
init.description: Manage maintenance tasks, add custom tasks, or register household equipment.

manage_tasks.title: Maintenance task selection
manage_tasks.description: Select the built-in and custom tasks to track. Configure intervals in the next step.

intervals.title: Maintenance intervals
intervals.description: Set the interval in days for each selected recurring task. Seasonal tasks use their season windows instead.

add_custom_task.title: Add a custom maintenance task
add_custom_task.description: Create a recurring task for something not included in the built-in library.

add_equipment.title: Register household equipment
add_equipment.description: Add an appliance or home system and optionally associate existing maintenance tasks with it. You can leave manufacturer, model, installation date, and notes blank.

data.name: Equipment name
data.task_ids: Maintenance tasks associated with this equipment

manage_equipment.title: Select household equipment
manage_equipment.description: Choose the equipment record you want to edit or remove.

equipment_actions.title: Equipment actions
equipment_actions.description: Edit the selected equipment record or remove it.

menu_options.edit_equipment: Edit equipment details and task links

edit_equipment.title: Edit household equipment
edit_equipment.description: Update the equipment details and associated maintenance tasks.

data.name: Equipment name
data.task_ids: Maintenance tasks associated with this equipment

remove_equipment.title: Remove household equipment
remove_equipment.description: Confirm removal of {equipment_name}. Existing maintenance history is retained.

data.confirm: I confirm that I want to remove this equipment record

manage_custom_tasks.title: Select a custom maintenance task
manage_custom_tasks.description: Choose the custom task you want to edit or remove.

custom_task_actions.title: Custom task actions
custom_task_actions.description: Edit the task details and interval, or remove this custom task.

edit_custom_task.title: Edit custom maintenance task
edit_custom_task.description: Update the name, category, description, or recurring interval. Existing completion history is retained.

remove_custom_task.title: Remove custom maintenance task
remove_custom_task.description: Confirm removal of {task_name}. Its completion history will be retained.
